manifest.construct: evidential tags (obs: / obs(<instrument>): / inf: / inf(<premises>): / rep(<src>): / rep(self-past):)
manifest.method: For each fixed matched pair and tokenizer, encode with tiktoken.get_encoding(model).encode(text); delta = tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english). Per-tokenizer value is the arithmetic mean across all pairs. Headline value is the maximum per-tokenizer mean (lower_better worst case). No special tokens.
manifest.sampling_note: Independent fresh ten-item set authored for this run before token calculation; all six filed evidential forms are represented, including two instrumented observations, two premise-bound inferences, external reports, and self-past recall. Each pair preserves one proposition and changes only the evidential rendering; no sentence is copied from the referenced original manifest.
